name: dsh-vscode-panel-workspace
description: VS Code panel for a running DeepSeek Harness Desktop (bridge plugin + extension)

scripts.vsix: node scripts/bundle-bridge.mjs && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && cd extension && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node esbuild.mjs && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
